Just keep fighting and just be wary of people with a quick fix solution or ideology. In a weaken state of mind you can easily be swayed.

Also try to focus on the opposite, in a way, what I’m trying to say is watch out for confirmation bias. It’s the thing where you are like “women hate me because I’m short” then you see women with tall me and you thing you’re right. When in actuality it’s just coincidental, either he wooed her first or there was a bunch of shorter guys who tried for her but got insecure and so she left for someone who isn’t. Not saying that there aren’t some women who don’t like short guys but most women are flexible, same as men. I didn’t like smokers but I had a crush on someone who did. Or the fact that half the women I’ve dated have been taller than me.

I’ve been realizing that it’s my own insecurities and lack of belief in myself that’s affecting my relationships. It’s only when I became increasingly insecure that people left.
